objective: Proof, written before the run: every new crossing joins splits separating the two end pairs; so SEED's verdict on a crossing-making fill depends only on those splits and the crossers of some crossed split; in a full two-way grid a split's crossers are a whole order.
status: Proved 2026-11-18 (referee pending): every new crossing joins splits separating the fill's two end pairs; SEED's verdict on a crossing-making fill is decided on those splits and a model's crossers; in a full two-way grid a model's crossers are a whole order.
title: The copy step is decided on the end pairs' splits and one model's crossers
